name: Enslaved: Peoples of the Historical Slave Trade
notes: Aggregates many contributed datasets rather than being one archive. Good broad first pass, not church-record-specific.

name: National Archives (NARA) — African American Heritage / Slavery Records
notes: Best for 1861-1877 Civil War/Reconstruction records. Most antebellum property/ownership records are NOT here — those are county-level. Slave schedules are tallies only, not name-searchable.

name: Brown University Library — Researching Slavery and the Slave Trade
notes: Portal, not a single database. Links to Slave Voyages, Race and Slavery Petitions Project (UNC Greensboro), Georgetown Slavery Archive, Columbia University & Slavery, DAACS, Sydney Howard Gay's Record of Fugitives, VA/MD runaway ad collections, WPA narratives reference.

name: Slave Societies Digital Archive (SSDA)
notes: Primary church-records source for Catholic colonial contexts. Does NOT cover Louisiana — do not treat 'Catholic colonial' as a sufficient match condition; coverage list is explicit and limited to Brazil, Cuba, Colombia, Spanish Florida. Angola collection viewable in person only at Vanderbilt.

name: Mid-Hudson Antislavery History Project (Vassar)
notes: Portal for a regional/local project. Links to NESRI, Slave Voyages, Intra-American slave trade database. Good template for county/regional projects generally.

name: Freedmen's Bureau Search Portal (NMAAHC / FamilySearch)
notes: Name-searchable index of Freedmen's Bureau records.

name: Freedom on the Move
notes: Database of runaway advertisements placed by enslavers.

name: Northeast Slavery Records Index (NESRI)
notes: Searchable index of individual enslaved persons and enslavers throughout the Northeast.

name: Digital Library on American Slavery (UNC Greensboro)
notes: Includes the Race and Slavery Petitions Project and ~35,000 voyage records.
